decisions.intent: Delete or Backspace a non-empty cross-block editor selection through one undoable mutation while preserving focus and code rendering.

preconditions: The user invokes Delete, Backspace, or the matching keyboard shortcut from a Protyle editor.
The resolved browser range either spans editable blocks with selected content or targets one or more referenced definition blocks.
stateTransitions: A Zod-backed CaliburRouter partitions non-mutating, cross-block-content, and reference-targeted deletion states before the transaction owner is called.
For a routed mutation, the editor publishes a typed user-operation intent before aborting the prior keydown flow and invoking the shared range-removal transaction.
The shared transaction removes selected ranges in one undoable update, removes empty boundary spans, restores the retained start focus, and invalidates affected code highlighting.
outputs: Delete and Backspace both reach the same cross-block transaction without browser-default partial deletion.
Plugins can observe the user, editor surface, keyboard trigger, operation kind, editor ID, affected block IDs, and reference-target count without receiving selected document content.
invariants: Only a router-confirmed mutation emits an intent event; ignored keyboard states publish nothing.
The public plugin event extends the official siyuan IEventBusMap and contains no internal IProtyle instance.
Existing single-block, image, table, AV, and list deletion branches retain their own established behavior.
failures: A declined reference confirmation leaves the editor DOM unchanged before any transaction is submitted.
A stale or disconnected target is handled by the existing shared removal path rather than applying a partial DOM mutation.
